author: Aaboud, M. and others
title: Measurement of the W-boson mass in pp collisions at sqrt(s)=7 TeV with the ATLAS detector
abstract: A measurement of the W boson mass based on 4.6 fb-1 of pp collisions at sqrt(s)=7 TeV. The W-boson mass is obtained from template fits to the charged lepton transverse momentum and the W boson transverse mass in the electron and muon decay channels: mW = 80370 +/- 7 (stat.) +/- 11 (exp. syst.) +/- 14 (mod. syst.) MeV. The W+ and W- mass difference yields mW+ - mW- = -29 +/- 28 MeV.
